subject: Brightway IAM intake & artifact request — SSO/SCIM/RBAC next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@brightwayhealth.com>, Emily Torres <emily.torres@brightwayhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Brightway IAM intake & artifact request — SSO/SCIM/RBAC next steps

Hi Sanjay / Emily —

Thanks again for the demo and the call this morning. Quick recap and what I need from you to keep the POC moving:

- SOC 2 status: you mentioned an external audit scheduled for Q4. Can you confirm whether you have an in-scope SOC 2 Type II report or a readiness assessment today? If not, a short note on timeline is fine.
- Data residency / HIPAA: please confirm whether the POC will require PHI handling; that dictates our hosting and BAA requirements.
- IAM artifacts we need for integration and security review (first pass):
  - SSO metadata (IdP metadata XML / SAML cert) or SAML endpoints
  - SCIM provisioning test account + sample user JSON or SCIM endpoint docs
  - Admin role definitions and current RBAC matrix (who can invite / delete / promote)

I attached a short checklist and a role-matrix template to make this painless. Ideally we get these items within 5 business days so engineering can plan the connector work and our security team can validate controls. If you prefer, we can take a staged approach: SSO + role matrix first, SCIM after initial validation.

Next steps I propose:
1) You share SSO/SCIM artifacts by EOD next Wednesday (7/31)
2) Redwood runs a quick configuration call (30 min) the week of 8/6
3) We confirm whether BAA / PHI is required and route procurement if needed

Any objections to that plan? Happy to adjust timelines.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood-iam-evidence-checklist-v1.pdf, brightway-role-matrix-template.csv

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@brightwayhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Torres <emily.torres@brightwayhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightway IAM intake & artifact request — SSO/SCIM/RBAC next steps

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type I report from earlier this year and expect to complete Type II in late Nov. I can get the Type I PDF to you for your review; Type II ETA is 2028-11-30 (target).
- PHI: the initial POC will not include PHI. Our plan is to test with synthetic data for the first cycle. If we expand, we'll loop in legal for a BAA.
- SSO/SCIM artifacts: we can provide IdP metadata and a SCIM test endpoint, but SCIM is currently behind a sandbox toggle. Emily will share who on our infra team owns that toggle.

We aim to share the SSO metadata and role matrix by Wednesday 7/31. SCIM test creds may take until 8/4 if infra needs to flip the sandbox.

Sanjay
Director, Platform Security
Brightway Health
S: (617) 555-8871

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightway IAM intake & artifact request — SSO/SCIM/RBAC next steps

Great — thanks Sanjay, that timeline works. Two small asks before you send artifacts:

1) For the role matrix, can you indicate which roles are scoped to admin-level actions (invite/promote/delete) vs. read-only? The CSV template has a column for "privilege level" — if you add names instead of IDs that will help our security review.
2) If you have a short write-up (1-2 bullets) on how you enforce least privilege for service accounts / automation, that will speed the control verification.

Once we receive the SSO metadata and role matrix we will:
- Spin up a staging config and attempt a test SAML auth (no SCIM needed yet)
- Share a short access-control findings note (1 page) within 48 hours of tests

If SCIM cre ds arrive by 8/4 we'll validate provisioning and reconcile attributes against your role matrix.

Thanks — looking forward to the artifacts on 7/31.

Best,
Hannah

---
Hannah reached out internally after receiving Sanjay's reply to confirm owners and timeline.

Ben — can you schedule a 30-min config call for week of 8/6? Prefer Thu 8/8 10:00-10:30 PT if open.
Marissa — please review the role-matrix when it arrives and flag any gaps in RBAC mapping. We'll include the 48-hour findings note as a deliverable in the POC scope.

Thanks,
Hannah
